reports.title: Why Normal People Cannot Understand Aarna
reports.author: Dr. V. K. Sharma, Lead Behavioral Analyst
reports.summary: Standard psychological models assume human choices follow rational self-interest. Subject Aarna completely disproves this thesis.
content: Across 800+ observed classroom hours, Subject Aarna exhibited behaviors defying conventional human logic. Example: Spending 20 minutes meticulously coloring a notebook title, then proceeding to sleep through the actual chapter.
When confronted about homework, Subject deployed an advanced psychological deflection known as 'The Innocent Puppy Glance', which reduced teacher reprimand probability by 78%.
Conclusion: Do not attempt to analyze using standard human psychology. Subject functions on an autonomous frequency powered by pure theatrical energy.

reports.title: Investigation Into Unnecessary Chaos
reports.author: Department of Thermodynamic Disturbances
reports.summary: Documenting spontaneous entropy spikes occurring in any room within 30 seconds of Subject's arrival.
content: In controlled corridor trials, peaceful silence was maintained for approximately 4 minutes. Upon Subject's entrance, immediate audible giggles, falling stationary, and heated debates regarding fictional drama ensued.
Researchers attempted to quantify the origin of the chaos. In 94% of cases, the trigger was a completely random statement uttered with zero prior context.
Field Directive: Do not extinguish the chaos. The chaos is a vital atmospheric nutrient.

reports.title: The Mysterious Case of Random Behaviour
reports.author: Committee for Unexplained Phenomena
reports.summary: Documenting sudden decisions to change moods, alter plans, or pretend to be deeply offended over a single stolen chip.
content: Case 12-B: Subject willingly surrendered her own lunch, yet declared an international crisis when one fry was claimed from her plate.
Subject exhibits sudden bursts of profound wisdom immediately preceded by declaring herself 'pgli gawar'.
Staff consensus: The juxtaposition of goofy chaos and deep emotional sincerity is her signature superpower.

reports.title: Why Researchers Have Stopped Asking Questions
reports.author: Council of Exhausted Observers
reports.summary: Formal resolution to cease all attempts at domesticating or classifying Subject Aarna.
content: After exhaustive review of all collected data—including video lecture drawings, corridor strolls, and stolen snack incidents—the council has concluded that classification is impossible.
Subject is simply herself. Funny, chaotic, radiant, and fiercely loyal.
Final Recommendation: Accept her with wholehearted love, provide snacks regularly, and never let anyone dim her light.

researcherNotes.note: We attempted to establish a calm, disciplined observation protocol. Subject told a joke. The entire research team began laughing. Protocol abandoned.
researcherNotes.author: Lab Tech #03

researcherNotes.note: Subject was caught on video lecture with forehead doodles and cheek scribbles. When asked to wipe them off, she smiled and posed. Heroic behavior.
researcherNotes.author: Archivist Maya

researcherNotes.note: Subject stole the lab director's sandwich. When confronted, she offered half of an old biscuit in trade. Legally speaking, a terrible deal. Emotionally, accepted.
researcherNotes.author: Senior Fellow Arjun

researcherNotes.note: Final conclusion after months of tracking: She's not just a subject. She's the heart of this entire institution.
researcherNotes.author: The Chief Investigator
